title: Did you know… Jesus didn’t build His movement with the “qualified”?
paragraphs: Did you know… Jesus didn’t build His movement with the “qualified”?
Skipped the religious elite who looked holy…
…and stopped for fishermen with rough hands and louder pasts.
Because religion says, “Clean yourself, then come.”
But Jesus says, “Come… and I’ll make you clean.”

In Matthew 4:19, He didn’t say,
“Prove yourself.”
Just a call… that rearranges everything.
Because Jesus doesn’t just improve your life.
You’re exactly the kind of person Jesus calls.
But the cross of Christ is louder than your past.
And the empty tomb proves this:

God doesn’t recruit the worthy.
He makes people worthy through Jesus.
If this stirred something in you, don’t ignore it.
